纵欲之后的后果就是——时笙第二天不想下床了。

她没想到凤辞持久性竟然那么好，简直是要大战三百回合。

要了本宝宝一条老命啊！

时笙不下床，凤辞自然也不敢下去，他下去了，时笙就要挨冻了。

“小殊，我会娶你的。”凤辞握着时笙的手，说得认真。

“嗯。”时笙有气无力的应了一声，应完才反应过来，“娶我？”

凤辞点头，末了想起时笙看不到，“娶你。”

时笙吱唔了一声，没在说话。

她喜欢凤辞吗？

自然是喜欢的，否则她也不会和他做这种事。

但是更深层面的……

她很清楚，自己是没办法将凤辞放到那个地方的。

第一她清楚知道自己只是在虚拟世界，对一个NPC产生深层感情的这种事她做不出来，第二她也没办法……将一个人放到至关重要的位置。

她的世界，不允许有那么一个人存在。

前面两个位面，不管是楚棠还是陆清韵，她和他们过了一生，她对他们仅仅是比朋友亲密一点，没有产生任何感情，最重要的一点是因为那两个人同样生性凉薄，她和他们是一样的人，绝不会让自己有弱点。

可是凤辞不同……

是啊，凤辞是不同的。

对她来说是不同的。

时笙沉默的从凤辞怀里爬起来，穿上衣服，下床，往前走了两步，她又顿住，没有回头的道：“我要静一静，别找我。”

她需要想一些事。

凤辞愣愣的看着时笙走出殿门，有那么一瞬间，他觉得她这么一走，就不会在回来了。

他脑中无数疯狂的念头犹如荒草一般滋生。

但是那些疯狂的念头被他理智的压了回去，如果他真的那么做了，她就真的不会在属于他了。

【宿主，你在纠结吗？】系统的声音自时笙脑子响起。

The consequence of the indulgence was that Shi Sheng didn't want to get out of bed the next day.

She didn't expect Feng Ci's durability to be so good. She would have to fight for three hundred rounds.

It’s going to take this baby’s life!

If Shi Sheng didn't get out of bed, Feng Ci would naturally not dare to go down. If he went down, Shi Sheng would be frozen.

"Xiao Shu, I will marry you." Feng Ci held Shi Sheng's hand and said seriously.

"Yeah." Shi Sheng responded feebly, and only then did he react, "Marry me?"

Feng Ci nodded, and finally remembered that Shi Sheng couldn't see her, "Marry you."

Shi Sheng squeaked and didn't speak.

Does she like Feng Ci?

Of course she likes him, otherwise she wouldn't do such a thing with him.

But on a deeper level...

She knew very well that there was no way she could put Feng Ci in that place.

First, she knew clearly that she was only in a virtual world and she couldn't develop deep feelings for an NPC. Second, she had no choice but to... put a person in a crucial position.

Her world does not allow such a person to exist.

In the first two planes, whether it was Chu Tang or Lu Qingyun, she had spent her whole life with them. She was just a little closer to them than friends and did not have any feelings for them. The most important thing was that those two people were also cold-blooded. She was the same person as them and would never let herself have weaknesses.

But Feng Ci is different...

Yes, Feng Ci is different.

It's different for her.

Shi Sheng silently climbed up from Feng Ci's arms, put on clothes, got out of bed, and took two steps forward. She paused again and said without looking back: "I want to be quiet, don't look for me."

She needed something to think about.

Feng Ci stared blankly at Shi Sheng walking out of the palace. For a moment, he felt that if she left like this, she would never come back.

Countless crazy thoughts grew in his mind like weeds.

But those crazy thoughts were suppressed by him rationally. If he really did that, she would really no longer belong to him.

[Host, are you confused?】The sound of the system rang in Shi Sheng's head.
